In this indictment, the man who can be seen here was allegedly executed by the police. He's missing half his head. You can see the knee protruding of one of the other people buried under the rubble. There's part of an arm here, or hand, of one of the other unfortunate people. You can see the dormitories.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] With this fast forward we seem to be losing quite a lot of the important elements. We don't have the volume, sound, and what we have been talking about, the fleeing of the prisoners from the premises and the way in which they were doing this.

utterances.speaker: MR. MILOSEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes. You can see that they tried to break down the door in their panic during the bombing.

utterances.speaker: RADOVAN PAPONJAK [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's right. And as I know this videotape, the soundtrack says how they tried to do this, and the crime technicians tried to show that. They used crowbars.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You can see the crowbars here, the levers and the forced door.

utterances.speaker: RADOVAN PAPONJAK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I hope that at least that portion has been translated.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Corpses once again. Take a look at this. This person is missing a head.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Faster forward. There is nothing gained from showing us these ghastly pictures.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is part of a bomb. You can see the serial number even here.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: The Chamber will probably recall and might be assisted to be reminded that of course there is no challenge to the fact that there was NATO bombing both on the 19th and the 21st of May, and I can provide details of the number of sorties and the number of bombs, if asked.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The number of casualties would be different.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: Yes. That's a matter of evidence, because after all -- well, it's all a matter of evidence, but information as to the number of -- the dates and number of sorties and number of bombs comes from NATO and it's not -- it's still a matter of evidence but it's somewhat clearer than -- clear evidence, if you want it.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Robinson, gentlemen, would you please bear in mind the fact that in attachment J, Schedule J, as it says in paragraph (k), you have a list of those allegedly executed, and there are 26 on that list. Our organs established over 90 killed in the bombing in Istok. And we're now going to follow that up.

utterances.speaker: MR. MILOSEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Colonel, can you just give us your brief comments of the footage we've just seen.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: No, Mr. Milosevic. There are several matters. One is a question -- the first one is a question of timing, because we have to adjourn now. And when we resume, I'd like to have specific questions put to the witness rather than to ask him to comment generally. Specific questions about the matters that are at issue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: We have another matter scheduled for hearing tomorrow morning starting at 9.00, but the parties are to be ready --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That was yesterday.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: -- the parties are to be here in the event that we are able to start this case at 10.00. So the parties should be here in readiness to recommence the hearing at 10.00. There is no certainty that this will take place, but the parties are to be here and to stand in readiness. We are adjourned until tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Robinson. Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Milosevic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Is it certain that we won't begin before 10.00? Is that a certainty?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: That may not be -- that may not be a certainty. But you don't need to be here until 10.00.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's all I wanted to know. Thank you.
